dct_title_s: Cuba Hurricane Melissa: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2025
dct_description_sm: # Cuba Hurricane Melissa: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Cuba Hurricane Melissa (Oct 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 30 October 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 30 October 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 29 October 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Cuba, Hurricane Melissa, 29 October 2025, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025)
